meta.title: Fish packing in Egypt: quality and ISO certificates
meta.description: Our plant in Motobas, Kafr El Sheikh washes, ices, grades, packs and inspects whole fresh fish. We hold ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

hero.title: Packing and quality at our plant in Motobas
hero.intro: We inspect every order before the boxes are closed, against the species, weight grade, packing and labels agreed with you.
hero.imageAlt: Whole fresh fish on crushed ice in white boxes, with staff in hygiene clothing working behind

chain.title: Five stages from farm to export

farming.title: Farming and sourcing
farming.text: We farm our own fish and buy from other producers.
farming.alt: Aerial view of earthen fish ponds with aerators and palm trees

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.text: Netted and taken to the plant.
harvest.alt: Two workers pulling a net full of tilapia to the bank of an earthen pond

packing.title: Washing, icing and packing
packing.text: Washed, iced, graded by weight and packed whole on ice in EPS foam boxes.
packing.alt: Gloved hands placing a whole tilapia into a crate of crushed ice on a steel table

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.alt: A gloved hand holding a probe in iced water beside two whole tilapia

export.title: Export
export.alt: A worker moving a pallet of white boxes into a refrigerated truck at a loading dock

chain.capacity: We pack up to 2,500 t/month. A refrigerated truck carries 20 t, and on some days more than five leave our plant.

certs.title: ISO certificates and EU export approval
certs.statement: We hold ISO certificates, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.

faq.title: Questions from quality teams
faq.q1: Which ISO standards do you hold?
faq.a1: We hold ISO 9001:2015 for quality management, ISO 14001:2015 for environmental management and ISO 45001:2018 for occupational health and safety, certified by TÜV AUSTRIA.
